<style>
/* This page is a standalone flyer, so it hides the site navbar rather than
   sitting under it. The other pages in the site keep theirs. Not scoped under
   .flyer: the navbar is a sibling of the content, outside it. */
body > header#quarto-header { display: none; }
#quarto-content { padding-top: 0; }
/* Empty, but still occupies space above the flyer. */
#title-block-header { display: none; }

/* Scoped under .flyer so it can't disturb the Quarto theme. */
.flyer, .flyer * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.flyer {
  --navy: #00205B;
  --gold: #b8912f;
  --ink:  #1a1a1a;
  --gray: #444;
  --mut:  #6b6b6b;
  --line: #e4e4e4;
  font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 8px 0 24px;
}

.flyer .sheet {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 900px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 24px 8px 8px;
  background: transparent;
}

/* ---- Masthead ---------------------------------------------------------- */

.flyer .display {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
  font-size: 44px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.flyer .logo { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.flyer .logo img { width: 260px; max-width: 60%; height: auto; }

.flyer .meta-inline {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px 18px;
}
.flyer .meta-inline span { font-size: 18px; color: #333; }
.flyer .meta-inline .dot { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; }

.flyer .subline {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #555;
  margin-top: 6px;
}
.flyer .subline b { color: var(--ink); }

/* Syllabus link under the masthead. An outlined pill so it reads as the one
   call to action up here without competing with the display title. */
.flyer .cta { text-align: center; margin-top: 18px; }
.flyer .cta a {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 9px 26px;
  border: 2px solid var(--navy);
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--navy);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
}
.flyer .cta a:hover,
.flyer .cta a:focus { background: var(--navy); color: #fff; text-decoration: none; }
.flyer .cta a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; }

.flyer .rule {
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin: 26px 0 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--navy) 0 62%, var(--gold) 62% 100%);
}

/* ---- Instructor ------------------------------------------- */

.flyer .instructor {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 22px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.flyer .instructor img { width: 130px; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; }
.flyer .instructor .who { font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--gray); }
.flyer .instructor .who .name {
  font-size: 21px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  display: block;
}
.flyer .instructor a { color: var(--navy); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
.flyer .instructor a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }


/* ---- Week headings ----------------------------------------------------- */

.flyer .section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin: 20px 0 10px;
}
.flyer .section-head .label,
.flyer .section-head .dates {
  font-size: 14px;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ---- Session rows ------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Three columns: date chip | title and description | download links.
   The chip is a plain label. Downloads are named links at the right of the
   row, so they are visible without hovering and work on touch. */

.flyer .item {
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 8px 0;
}

.flyer .chip {
  flex: 0 0 152px;
  background: var(--navy);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 6px 0 7px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: block;
}

/* Second line of the chip. This course meets on an irregular calendar -- two
   1.5-hour Thursday evenings a fortnight apart, and two 4.5-hour Saturdays
   split into a first and second half -- so the date alone does not identify a
   session. The two halves of a Saturday share a date and differ only here. */
.flyer .chip .chip-time {
  display: block;
  font-size: 11.5px;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  margin-top: 1px;
}

/* flex-basis 0 so the text shrinks to share the row rather than wrapping
   below the chip once .item is allowed to wrap on narrow screens. */
.flyer .item-body {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
}
.flyer .item-title {
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
}
/* A session whose topic is not settled yet. */
.flyer .item-title.tbd {
  color: var(--mut);
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: italic;
}
.flyer .item-desc {
  font-size: 15.5px;
  color: var(--gray);
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* padding-top matches the chip's own top padding, so the links sit on the
   chip's text baseline rather than riding above it. */
.flyer .item-links {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-top: 7px;
}
.flyer .item-links a {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--navy);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.flyer .item-links a:hover,
.flyer .item-links a:focus { text-decoration: underline; }
.flyer .item-links a:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--gold);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.flyer .item-links .sep {
  color: var(--gold);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 7px;
}

/* The links are right-aligned, so a row with no Files download would pull its
   Slides link further right than its neighbours'. A phantom copy of the dot and
   the word reserves that width without showing it, keeping every Slides link on
   one vertical line. visibility:hidden (not display:none) is what holds the
   box open, and it also takes the text out of the accessibility tree and out of
   tab order, so there is nothing to click or hear. Must match the font of the
   real links or it reserves the wrong width. */
.flyer .item-links .phantom {
  visibility: hidden;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* "Slides" links straight to the HTML deck, and hovering it offers the choice
   of HTML or PDF. Touch devices have no hover, so a tap just follows the link
   to the HTML deck, which is the sensible default. */
.flyer .has-menu {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
}
/* No overflow:hidden here -- it would clip the ::before bridge below, which is
   what lets the pointer cross the gap. The corners are rounded on the child
   links instead. Hiding is delayed so a brief slip off the menu does not
   close it before it can be clicked; showing stays instant. */
.flyer .has-menu .submenu {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(100% + 6px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  z-index: 20;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity 0.12s 0.4s, visibility 0s 0.52s;
}
/* Spans the gap, with slack either side for an imprecise pointer. */
.flyer .has-menu .submenu::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -10px;
  left: -12px;
  width: calc(100% + 24px);
  height: 10px;
}
.flyer .has-menu:hover .submenu,
.flyer .has-menu:focus-within .submenu {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transition: opacity 0.12s 0s, visibility 0s 0s;
}
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a {
  display: block;
  padding: 6px 16px;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-align: center;
}
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:first-child { border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; }
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:last-child  { border-radius: 0 0 5px 5px; }
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a + a { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:hover,
.flyer .has-menu .submenu a:focus {
  background: #eef1f6;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* Nothing posted for that session yet: the link still occupies its place in
   the row and leads to the Under Construction page, so the schedule reads the
   same all term and only the hrefs change. */
.flyer .item-links a.pending { color: var(--mut); font-weight: 600; }

/* ---- Footer ------------------------------------------------------------ */

.flyer .sheet-foot {
  margin-top: 28px;
  padding-top: 18px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
}
.flyer .sheet-foot a {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--navy);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.flyer .sheet-foot .url  { font-size: 20px; }

/* ---- Narrow screens ---------------------------------------------------- */

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .flyer .display { font-size: 30px; }
  .flyer .chip { flex-basis: 116px; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .flyer .chip .chip-time { font-size: 10.5px; }
  .flyer .item-title { font-size: 17px; }

  /* Too narrow for a third column, so the links wrap onto their own line,
     indented to line up with the session title above them. */
  .flyer .item { flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .flyer .item-links {
    flex: 1 0 100%;
    margin-left: 0;
    padding-left: 132px;
    padding-top: 5px;
  }
  .flyer .item-links a { font-size: 14px; }
}
</style>

<!-- Each row carries two links: Slides (with an HTML/PDF submenu) and Files.
     The narrated pre-session video ships inside that session's Files bundle
     rather than getting a link of its own.

     To post a session's material, edit that row's item-links div: drop the
     class="pending" and swap the three under-construction.html paths for the
     deck's .html (twice -- the Slides link itself and the HTML submenu entry),
     its .pdf, and the session zip. Fill in the item-title and item-desc at the
     same time and drop the tbd class.

     Keep an item-links div's contents on one line: the links are inline, so a
     line break between them would show up as an extra space around the dot.
     Paths are relative to docs/, e.g. slides/session01.html. Anything linked
     must also be listed under resources: in _quarto.yml.

     If a session ends up with no PDF, drop the has-menu and submenu spans and
     leave a plain <a href="PATH" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Slides</a>.

     If a session ends up with no Files zip, replace the real dot and link with
     the phantom spans: <span class="sep phantom">&middot;</span><span
     class="phantom">Files</span>. They are invisible but hold the width open,
     so that row's Slides link stays in line with the others'.

     Every link here opens in a new tab, so keep the target and rel on any
     you add.                                                              -->
